verdict.rationale: Operating a telephony product through natural-language commands is a fair axis for Google Voice, but the evidence pack never documents such an interface. The nearest items are text-to-speech greetings for auto attendants and AI-assisted note-taking, which are adjacent features and not natural-language control of the product. Probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI surface either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
